name: multi_turn
description: Tests conversation continuity across multiple turns: context retention, topic switching, drill-down

tests.description: Bot retains context from previous turn (NymCard N4B details)
tests.input: What does the KYB onboarding flow look like?

conversation.content: N4B is a white-label Corporate BaaS platform for MENA financial institutions. It covers card issuance, corporate hierarchy, KYB/IDV onboarding, Visa Direct cross-border payments, and RBAC approval workflows.
What does the KYB onboarding flow look like?

tests.description: Bot handles topic switch from NymCard to Tamara
tests.input: What did you build at Tamara?

conversation.content: At NymCard I lead product for N4B and Lynq — white-label BaaS platforms for MENA financial institutions.
What did you build at Tamara?

tests.description: Bot provides deeper detail on progressive drill-down
tests.input: How exactly did the API portal revamp cut integration time?

conversation.content: Five main ones: NymCard N4B and Lynq (current), Compound SNBL, Tamara Partners Portal 2.0, Tamara API Reference Portal, and 100+ merchant integrations at Mondia Pay.
Tell me more about the API Reference Portal at Tamara
I led the revamp of Tamara's developer reference portal as Integration Delivery Manager — cut integration GTM time by 25% and enabled 100M+ SAR GMV for merchants.
How exactly did the API portal revamp cut integration time?

tests.description: Bot doesn't repeat the same formulation across turns
tests.input: What else can you tell me?

conversation.content: 8+ years across BaaS, carrier billing, and BNPL. Currently leading N4B and Lynq at NymCard — white-label Corporate BaaS platforms for MENA financial institutions.
What else can you tell me?

assertions.criteria: The response should provide NEW information not already mentioned in the previous assistant message. It should NOT simply restate the same points about NymCard N4B and Lynq in the same way.

tests.description: Bot returns to previous topic correctly
tests.input: Going back to Compound — what was the checkout widget for?

conversation.content: At Compound I was Product Lead for a Save Now Buy Later (SNBL) product — defined savings plans, customer app, checkout widget, admin portal, and API docs.
